name: mod-filetree
description: A sidebar tree of the files Claude touched this session, marked read, edited, written or created with the latest action lit while it works, and a replay that steps through the last turn's edits one diff at a time. Opens from /mod-filetree or the Files entry in the mod-menu pill

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one

show_reads.title: Show files Claude only read
show_reads.description: The tree lists files Claude read as well as the ones it changed. Off, it lists only changed files

wrap_diff.title: Wrap long diff lines
wrap_diff.description: Long lines in the replay wrap onto the next row. Off, they are cut at the pane edge

recent_turns.title: Turns in the recent view
recent_turns.description: How many of the latest turns the middle view of the tree covers, from 2 to 20
